description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 11.09.2023 to 17.09.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for import/export activities, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish the authority behind the regulatory change, not to announce a personnel appointment or describe ministerial portfolios.
